## About Me

A junior undergrad @ Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), with a major in the **Zhiyuan Honors Program** (*Physics Track*) and a minor in **Computer Science**.

My research interests lie on 

- **representation learning and multimodal generative modeling**. Particularly, I am interested in audio-visual generation (T2I/T2V/I2V), speech understanding and generation (ASR/TTS), and world models. 
- **Science4AI**, especially combining physical insights with AI to improve neural networks and solve scientific problems.

You can find a detailed summary of my research interests and experiences in my [CV](files/cv_TengyueZhang_26May.pdf).

## Publications

Jiatong Zhao\*, **Tengyue Zhang**\*, Yuhan Wang\*, Fuyuan Wu, Junchi Yan. *Co4ICF: Co-evolving Physics-Informed Surrogate and RL-based Pulse Optimizer for Inertial Confinement Fusion*. The 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD ‘26) (\* Equal Contribution)

## About Future

Now I am seeking a **summer research / intern opportunity** for 2026 Summer, 
and I am planning to pursue a Ph.D. in **Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence** starting in Fall 2027.

Please feel free to contact me if interested.
